reason: The company is significantly expanding its vertical integration by establishing a 1.2 GW TOPCon solar cell manufacturing facility, moving deeper into the solar value chain.
why_now: The expansion was officially announced in a press release dated October 10, 2026.
source_headlines: Oswal Pumps Limited: Oswal Pumps Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 10, 2026, titled "Oswal Pumps to set up 1.2 GW TOPCon solar cell manufacturing facility; deepens backward integration across the solar value chain".
